description: Adversaries may use brute force techniques to gain access to accounts by systematically attempting passwords or other authentication information.
detection: Multiple failed authentication attempts may indicate brute force activity.
response: Temporarily lock or restrict the targeted account
Reset credentials if compromise is suspected

description: Adversaries may attempt to gain access to accounts by repeatedly guessing passwords.
detection: Repeated authentication failures targeting a specific account can indicate password guessing.

description: Adversaries may use phishing techniques to obtain information or deliver malicious content through deceptive messages.
detection: Suspicious emails, malicious links, or credential harvesting attempts may indicate phishing.
response: Block the malicious URL or domain

description: Adversaries may rely on users executing malicious files to compromise systems.
detection: Execution of suspicious or malicious files on an endpoint may indicate compromise.

description: Adversaries may encrypt data to interrupt availability and cause operational impact.
detection: Rapid encryption or modification of multiple files may indicate ransomware activity.

description: Adversaries may exploit vulnerabilities in Internet-facing applications to gain access to systems.
detection: Suspicious requests or exploitation patterns targeting web applications may indicate exploitation.

description: Adversaries may perform denial-of-service attacks to prevent users from accessing targeted resources.
detection: Abnormally high volumes of network traffic may indicate a denial-of-service attack.

description: Adversaries may exploit software vulnerabilities to obtain higher-level privileges.
detection: Unexpected privilege changes or exploitation activity may indicate privilege escalation.
response: Disable or restrict the affected account

description: Adversaries may steal data by transferring it over an existing command and control channel.
detection: Unexpected transfers of sensitive data to external destinations may indicate data exfiltration.

description: Adversaries may scan systems to identify available services and potential attack targets.
detection: Repeated connection attempts across many ports or systems may indicate network scanning.
